items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: So Frankie wanted me to join The Four Lovers. So I continued – I wanted to continue to go to school so I quit the band I was in and went to work with Frankie Valli and The Four Lovers playing bass.

ctx.x: All that like gets inside you I think, and later on you may not even remember where it came from but you use it.

Well one of the things that I learned later on was I was not a great player. But musicians loved the arrangements and I knew how to make the arrangements sound great because of the accordion, because I could harmonize and play the in-between notes with the accordion so the chords would always sound full. And that was basically how I met Frankie Valli. He came into a club that I was working in. I had graduated high school. I was going to Manhattan School of Music and still working with a band. And he walked into a…
What did he particularly notice? Because -- did you have horn players? How large was the band?
